description: A hand-written two-crate workspace whose cdylib is a wasm32-wasip2 component: panic locations, file!/line!/module_path! and std formatting put every path rustc can embed into the bytes.

files.plugin/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "fixture-plugin"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib"]
[dependencies]
fixture-core = { path = "../core" }
files.plugin/src/lib.rs:
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn probe(n: u32) -> u32 { fixture_core::table(n).len() as u32 + fixture_core::risky(&[1, 2, 3], n as usize) + fixture_core::site().len() as u32 }

control.description: The negative control: the same plugin with one dependency from a directory source. Cargo hashes the absolute path of such a source into the crate's metadata, so the component's bytes depend on the checkout path and the comparison of the proof must see it.

files.plugin/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "fixture-plugin"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib"]
[dependencies]
fixture-core = { path = "../core" }
fixture-vendored = "1"
files.plugin/src/lib.rs:
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn probe(n: u32) -> u32 { fixture_core::table(n).len() as u32 + fixture_core::risky(&[1, 2, 3], n as usize) + fixture_core::site().len() as u32 + fixture_vendored::here().len() as u32 + fixture_vendored::boom(Some(n)) }
files.vendor/fixture-vendored/src/lib.rs:
pub fn here() -> &'static str { file!() }
pub fn boom(v: Option<u32>) -> u32 { v.expect("vendored") }
